3d149b57541b8357acc5.title: Senior Specialist, Procurement
3d149b57541b8357acc5.description:
**Description of Position**
---------------------------

Reporting to the Director of Procurement & Contract Services, the Senior Procurement Specialist performs advanced professional and technical procurement work supporting the College's mission and responsible stewardship of public funds. The position plans, develops, conducts, evaluates, awards, and administers formal and informal competitive solicitations and contracts across a broad range of commodities, services, technology, equipment, and professional engagements. Current assignments may include information technology and Software-as-a-Service solutions, Career and Technical Education equipment, and marketing and creative services; portfolio assignments may change based on College needs.
  
  
The position partners with academic and administrative departments to translate operational needs into clear specifications and scopes of work; facilitates objective evaluation processes; negotiates commercial and public-sector terms; and maintains complete, auditable procurement and contract records. Work requires sound independent judgment, strong customer service, attention to detail, and consistent application of College policies, applicable Arizona public procurement requirements, grant conditions, and federal regulations when applicable.
  
  
**Please note:** Preference will be given to local Prescott candidates working on-site Monday through Friday, with the opportunity to work remotely one day per week once fully up to speed. Fully remote candidates residing in the greater Phoenix, Arizona area may be considered based on exceptional experience and a willingness to travel to Prescott approximately once per month to work with the team in person. Relocation assistance is not available, and out-of-state candidates will not be considered.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  
1. Solicitations and Strategic Sourcing (35%)

* Plans, drafts, issues, and administers formal and informal solicitations, including Invitations for Bids (IFBs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Qualifications (RFQs), and requests for quotations, from initial planning through award and contract implementation.
* Manages assigned procurements that may include information technology that may include computers, network and classroom technology, enterprise software, cloud-hosted applications, cybersecurity tools, telecommunications, and Software-as-a-Service solutions. Coordinates with Information Technology, data owners, accessibility personnel, and other stakeholders to address information security, privacy, FERPA, data ownership, records retention, integration, service levels, and accessibility documentation such as VPATs and Section 508 conformance.
* Manages assigned procurements that may include Career and Technical Education requirements that may include CNC and manufacturing technology, welding and automotive equipment, simulators, laboratory or instructional systems, specialized tools, and related installation, training, warranty, utility, safety, and maintenance requirements.
* Manages assigned procurements that may include marketing and institutional advancement requirements that may include branding, media buying, digital advertising, website and creative services, photography and video production, printing, promotional products, market research, and related professional services.
* Conducts market research; identifies qualified suppliers and cooperative contracts; analyzes total cost of ownership, pricing structures, licensing metrics, renewal exposure, implementation requirements, warranties, support models, and supplier performance risks.
* Plans and facilitates pre-solicitation meetings, pre-bid conferences, site visits, demonstrations, interviews, and proposal evaluation committees. Trains committee members on confidentiality, conflicts of interest, scoring requirements, documentation, and objective evaluation practices.
* Prepares award recommendations, bid tabulations, evaluation summaries, negotiation documentation, notices, and other procurement records that clearly support the basis for selection and best value determination.

2. Contract Development, Administration, and Compliance (35%)
  

* Reviews, drafts, negotiates, and administers contracts, amendments, renewals, purchase orders, statements of work, software license agreements, SaaS agreements, master service agreements, equipment purchase and maintenance agreements, and professional service agreements within delegated authority.
* Reviews supplier terms for commercial, operational, and public-sector risk, including pricing and escalation, automatic renewal, payment, ownership and licensing, confidentiality, data security, accessibility, indemnification, insurance, warranties, service levels, termination, governing law, audit rights, and records requirements. Coordinates legal, risk, information security, accessibility, and department review as appropriate.
* Interprets and explains College procurement policies, procedures, competitive requirements, documentation standards, delegated authority, and applicable grant or funding restrictions to departments and suppliers.
* Evaluates and uses cooperative purchasing contracts, including Arizona and national cooperative agreements, when the procurement method is authorized, the scope supports the requirement, pricing is fair and reasonable, and contract terms align with College needs and applicable law.
* Monitors contract milestones, renewals, pricing, deliverables, supplier compliance, and available remedies. Supports departments in resolving product deficiencies, service failures, billing discrepancies, software performance issues, and delivery, installation, or warranty disputes.
* Analyzes purchase requisitions, quotes, supporting documentation, and proposed purchasing methods for compliance, completeness, funding alignment, and operational readiness before commitment of College funds.

3. Customer Service and Internal Advisory Support (20%)
  

* Partners with academic, Information Technology, Facilities, Marketing, Finance, and other departments early in project planning to establish procurement strategies, realistic schedules, evaluation methods, implementation milestones, and contract administration responsibilities.
* Advises departments in developing clear, competitive, and outcome-based specifications, scopes of work, service levels, acceptance criteria, supplier qualifications, pricing schedules, and evaluation criteria.
* Explains procurement options and requirements in a practical, service-oriented manner while maintaining fairness, transparency, confidentiality, and consistent treatment of suppliers.
* Uses College financial, e-procurement, electronic signature, and contract management systems to process and track requisitions, purchase orders, solicitations, agreements, renewals, and supplier performance information.
* Develops and delivers procurement guidance, templates, checklists, desk procedures, and training materials for College employees and evaluation committee members.

4. Records, Reporting, and Other Duties (10%)
  

* Maintains complete, organized, and auditable procurement and contract files in accordance with College procedures, public records requirements, applicable records retention schedules, and grant documentation requirements.
* Maintains solicitation and contract templates, standard forms, cooperative contract documentation, supplier records, and assigned procurement procedures.
* Compiles procurement activity, savings, cycle time, competition, contract status, supplier performance, and compliance information for management reporting and continuous improvement.
* Participates in supplier outreach, training, professional development, site walks, equipment inspections, and cross-functional College initiatives.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Expectations & Requirements**
---------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Associate degree from a regionally accredited institution in business administration, public administration, supply chain management, finance, information technology, or a closely related field.

**Experience:**

* Three years of progressively responsible experience in Arizona public procurement, with demonstrated experience applying Arizona public-sector procurement requirements, including purchasing, sourcing, competitive solicitations, contracting, or closely related activities.

* Experience developing or administering informal or formal competitive procurements, including specifications or scopes of work, supplier communications, quote or proposal analysis, and award documentation.
* Working knowledge of purchasing cycles, including requisition review, competitive sourcing, purchase order issuance, receiving, contract administration, and invoice resolution.
* An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may be considered.

  
**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to analyze detailed technical and commercial information, organize multiple procurements and deadlines, and produce clear, accurate, and defensible written work.

* Public procurement principles and practices, including competition, ethics, transparency, specifications, evaluation, negotiation, award, contract administration, sole-source justification, emergency procurement, cooperative purchasing, and documentation of fair and reasonable pricing.
* General understanding of Arizona public procurement practices, College purchasing policies, public records obligations, and federal requirements applicable to federally funded purchases.
* Commercial and operational considerations associated with SaaS licensing, cloud hosting, data security, accessibility, implementation, integrations, service levels, renewals, and software support.
* Equipment procurement considerations such as delivery, installation, utilities, site readiness, training, safety, warranty, maintenance, acceptance testing, and total cost of ownership.
* Professional services procurement considerations such as deliverables, approval rights, intellectual property, media usage, performance measures, fee structures, change control, and schedule management.
* Ability to interpret policies and contract terms; identify risks; develop practical options; and elevate legal, security, accessibility, safety, funding, or operational concerns to the appropriate reviewer.
* Ability to communicate effectively and diplomatically in writing and verbally with employees, suppliers, evaluation committee members, technical personnel, and leadership.
* Ability to negotiate favorable and balanced business terms while preserving integrity, fairness, confidentiality, and public accountability.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records in a high-volume service environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and the ability to learn College financial, procurement, contract management, and records systems.
* Demonstrates the ability to appropriately use artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies to support job responsibilities, improve efficiency, and enhance the quality of work. Uses AI tools responsibly and in accordance with College policies, data privacy, security, confidentiality, and applicable legal and ethical requirements. Exercises professional judgment when reviewing and using AI-generated information.

**Preferred Skills & Abilities**
--------------------------------

Position Summary
  
The Downstream Process Development Associate Scientist will support viral vector process development activities, including process optimization, scale-up, technology transfer to manufacturing, and on-the-floor production support. This role is responsible for integrating downstream process development with analytical evaluation to ensure robust, scalable, and high-quality viral vector manufacturing processes.
  
The successful candidate will possess strong written and verbal communication skills and will actively contribute to technical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, technical training, report generation, and GMP-compliant documentation. The individual will play a key role in supporting process development, manufacturing readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.

2461fac4265fc74f640c.title: Supplier Quality Representative (SQR) – Precast Concrete
2461fac4265fc74f640c.description:
**Location Requirement:** Candidate must reside within reasonable commuting distance of the assigned supplier location in Eastern Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Southern New York.

**Schedule:** Full-Time | Monday through Friday, 5 days per week

**Experience / Qualifications:**

* Minimum **1+ year of precast concrete experience**
* Formal certification is **preferred but not required**
* Candidate should be local to Eastern Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Southern New York

**Job Responsibilities:**  
The SQR will provide full-time, on-site quality oversight related to precast concrete activities. Responsibilities include witnessing and/or reviewing the following:

* Forming
* Concrete pours
* Post-pour inspections
* Documentation reviews
* Shipping preparation
* Release for shipment

**Supply Chain - Supplier Quality and Expediting**

Position Summary

This position entails visits to supplier and vendor shops to perform the activities defined by the quality surveillance assignment. The Supplier Quality Representative verifies, through monitoring, observation, document review, witnessing of examinations and tests, and selective hands-on inspection, that supplier-furnished material and equipment includes the defined attributes of recognized codes and standards and company procurement document requirements. Rejects material found nonconforming to procurement document requirements. Collaborates with the supplier and project supplier quality personnel to identify a course of action to achieve satisfactory disposition of disclosed nonconformances, releases conforming material for shipment, and reports surveillance results to company project personnel and the customer.

Responsibilities

The Supplier Quality Representative represents the company as the supplier’s primary contact and performs quality surveillance activities defined by the assignment scope to verify that supplier-furnished material and equipment conforms to the technical and quality requirements of the procurement documents. Acting in this capacity, the Supplier Quality Representative performs the following:

Requirements and Pre-Fabrication Readiness

* Reviews the procurement document requirements with supplier representatives to ensure they are understood and implemented, including client-specific and code-driven requirements.
* Participates in kickoff and pre-fabrication meetings; confirms witness and hold points, inspection and test planning, documentation deliverables, and traceability expectations before production begins.
* Verifies that qualified procedures, qualified personnel, calibrated equipment, current approved drawings and revisions, and released material are in place prior to the start of work.

Surveillance and Verification

* Performs the surveillance activities defined by the assignment and the company's quality surveillance plan, which establishes what the company verifies and at what level; the supplier’s inspection and test plan governs the supplier’s own regime, and the two meet at witness and hold points.
* Monitors supplier personnel activities, including the witnessing of operations, inspections, examinations, or tests, to verify purchase order document requirements have been met - first operation and nondestructive examination, welding, fit-up and dimensional verification, blasting and coating, pressure and functional testing, final inspection, factory acceptance testing, and pre-shipment verification.
* Reviews supplier-generated quality verification documentation to verify conformance to procurement document requirements, including material test reports, traceability and heat records, nondestructive examination reports, personnel and procedure qualifications, calibration records, coating records, and data books.
* Verifies that sub-suppliers and subcontracted operations are disclosed, qualified, and controlled, and that sub-tier findings and records are included in supplier reporting.
* Reviews supplier documents submitted to the company with or without comments; does not sign, initial, stamp, or otherwise endorse supplier inspection and test plans or other supplier documents.

Nonconformance and Corrective Action

* Rejects material found nonconforming and documents the condition objectively with reference to the governing requirement and supporting photographic evidence.
* Collaborates with the supplier and project supplier quality personnel to identify a course of action to achieve satisfactory disposition of disclosed nonconformances; refers design-driven items to the Responsible Engineer for technical disposition.
* Verifies corrective action in the shop using supplier evidence together with the representative’s own observation; ensures open actions carry an owner, due date, closure evidence, and follow-up verification, and reports repeat findings and adverse trends.

Release, Reporting, and Schedule Interface

* Releases conforming material for shipment and notifies other company functional organizations to assist in coordination of their activities.
* Reports the results of quality surveillance activities to provide company project personnel and the customer with the status of surveillance activities, using timely and accurate surveillance reports as the auditable record of attendance, observations, and actions.
* Provides early notification of quality or fabrication progress risk to the Area Supervisor and project supplier quality personnel, and coordinates with area expediting personnel so quality and progress status are consistent.
* Supports remote and technology-enabled surveillance, including hands-free video collaboration, three-dimensional scanning, and model overlay tools that extend Engineering and project visibility into the shop; these tools supplement, and do not replace, in-shop presence and judgment.
* Maintains assignment, notice-of-inspection, finding, certification, and photographic records in the applicable company systems.

Qualifications and Skills

Basic Qualifications

* Two years of related experience involving 2,000 hours of in-shop surveillance, examination, or testing activities; or
* High school diploma or equivalent and 1,000 hours of in-shop surveillance, examination, or testing activities; or
* Associate Degree, or the equivalent of two years of full-time college coursework in a related discipline, plus 500 hours of in-shop related experience in equivalent inspection, examination, or testing activities.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel routinely to supplier facilities within the assigned area.
* Ability to obtain and maintain any client, facility, or export-control access required for assigned suppliers.

Additional Qualifications

* The demonstrated ability to work under moderate supervision and to reach defensible conclusions independently while in a supplier facility.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear and factual surveillance report writing.
* Computer skills must consist of a working knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet applications, electronic submission of reports and assignment tracking, and digital camera use.
* Additional hours of in-shop quality surveillance or related experience with equipment or materials common to the company marketplace.
* Commodity experience in one or more of the following: structural steel and plate work; piping, spools, valves, and supports; pressure vessels, exchangers, tanks, and skids or modules; rotating equipment and packaged units; electrical and instrumentation equipment, including transformers, switchgear, and e-houses; protective coatings and linings; precast and prestressed concrete products.
* Working familiarity with the applicable codes and standards for the assigned commodity, such as the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (Sections I, V, VIII, and IX), ASME B31.1 and B31.3, AWS D1.1, API standards, and AMPP/SSPC coating standards.
* Industry certifications such as ASNT Level II in one or more nondestructive examination methods, AWS Certified Welding Inspector, AMPP/NACE coating inspector, or NPCA Production and Quality School certification.
* Experience with quality programs applicable to the assignment, including ISO 9001, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, or NQA-1.
* Experience on engineering, procurement, and construction projects in energy, nuclear, liquefied natural gas, mining and metals, or major infrastructure.
* Experience with supplier assessment, surveillance level determination, supplier requalification, or supplier document and certification data book control.
* Experience with international suppliers and translated documentation; a second language relevant to the assigned region is an advantage.
* Ability to work safely in an industrial fabrication environment with exposure to noise, heat, cold, dust, fumes, and moving equipment, wearing required personal protective equipment at all times.
* Ability to climb ladders and stairs, work at elevation, enter confined or restricted spaces where authorized, stand and walk for extended periods, and lift and carry inspection equipment of approximately 25 pounds.
* Vision and hearing, with correction as needed, sufficient to perform visual examination and witness testing.
* Include any and all industry certifications with your resume, including issue and expiration dates.

**Compensation Structure (Weekly Base + Performance Tiered Inbound & Outbound Commissions):** We believe in rewarding real results. Our transparent pay structure gives you a reliable weekly base for shift availability and scheduling duties, plus uncapped commissions on every completed job you close:

* **Weekly Base Retainer:** **$150/ week** *(adjust to your exact target)* for shift availability between **9:00 AM – 5:00 PM**, promptly answering incoming calls/texts, and accurately entering all bookings into **ServiceMonster**.
* **Inbound Lead Closing Commission (Tiered):** Earn commission on the gross revenue of every completed & collected job that you close from incoming company phone calls or SMS leads, based on your monthly closing rate:
* **Monthly Closing Rate under 30%:** **3% commission**
* **Monthly Closing Rate 30-35%:** **5% commission**
* **Monthly Closing Rate above 35%:** **7% commission** *(The better you close, the more you make!)*
* **Outbound / Self-Generated Sales Commission (Uncapped):** During quieter hours, reach out to local businesses, property managers, or homeowners to generate your own leads and earn:
* **8% commission** on self-generated **Residential** bookings (completed & collected).
* **10% commission** on self-generated **Commercial** contracts/jobs (completed & collected).
* *(Realistic total earning potential:* ***$1,200 – $2,500+/month*** *working remotely from home, depending on your closing rate and outbound hustle!)*

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Fast Lead Response (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM):** Answer incoming phone calls and promptly call/follow up with incoming SMS and online leads (speed-to-lead is critical!).
* **Consultative Closing:** Provide accurate estimates over the phone/text, educate customers on our 1–3 hour dry-time process, overcome price questions, and close bookings with a warm, helpful attitude.
* **ServiceMonster Scheduling (Included in Base Role):** Accurately enter all booked jobs, customer details, and notes into **ServiceMonster**, ensuring smooth technician routing and calendar management.
* **Proactive Outbound Sales (Optional High-Earning Path):** During open time slots, conduct outbound calls/emails to local commercial accounts, realtors, or past clients to generate new business.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* **Great Phone Presence:** Warm, confident, and articulate—someone who can "smile through the phone" and build instant trust with homeowners and business managers.
* **Reliable Availability (9 AM – 5 PM):** Attentive and responsive during daytime hours so no lead slips through the cracks.
* **Tech-Savvy & Detail-Oriented:** Comfortable learning and navigating CRM/scheduling software (**ServiceMonster** experience is a plus, full training provided) and business phone/SMS apps.
* **Sales-Driven Mindset:** Comfortable asking for the booking and naturally suggesting add-on services (e.g., upholstery, tile & grout, pet odor treatments) to maximize job value.
* **Local Knowledge:** Familiarity with the Carper cleaning business or home service business is a big plus.

**Job Types:** Part-time, Contract, Remote

**How to Apply:** Please submit your resume along with a brief note about your customer service or sales experience. Qualified candidates will be contacted for a quick 5-minute phone screen!

Pay: $18.00 - $35.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Do you have a quiet home workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and the ability to promptly return incoming customer text/phone leads within 5–10 minutes during daytime hours?
* In 2–3 sentences, tell us about a time you handled customer inquiries or turned a hesitant lead into a successful booking/sale.

Work Location: Remote

**Position Overview**

Blanco, Inc. is seeking a customer-focused and detail-oriented Packaging Customer Account Specialist to manage day-to-day customer account activities and support order coordination. This position serves as a primary point of contact for customer inquiries, packaging orders, product availability, order updates, and account documentation.

The ideal candidate has strong communication skills, enjoys building customer relationships, and can coordinate multiple orders and account requests while maintaining accurate records and reliable service.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Account Management**

* Serve as a primary contact for assigned customer accounts and routine service requests.
* Respond to customer questions regarding packaging products, pricing, orders, and delivery schedules.
* Maintain accurate customer profiles, account details, and communication records.
* Follow up with customers to confirm order requirements and address outstanding requests.
* Build positive working relationships through timely and professional communication.

**Packaging Order Coordination**

* Receive, review, and process customer packaging orders.
* Verify product specifications, quantities, pricing, and requested delivery dates.
* Coordinate with internal sales, production, and warehouse teams to support order fulfillment.
* Monitor order progress and communicate updates or potential delays.
* Assist with resolving order discrepancies, changes, and fulfillment concerns.

**Account Support & Documentation**

* Maintain customer account files, order histories, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare quotations, order confirmations, and routine account correspondence.
* Update customer information and order details in internal systems.
* Track open orders, pending requests, and account follow-ups.
* Assist with preparing account activity reports for management.

**Cross-Department Coordination**

* Communicate customer requirements to relevant internal departments.
* Coordinate with production and inventory personnel regarding product availability.
* Work with shipping and logistics teams to confirm delivery arrangements.
* Escalate pricing questions, product concerns, and complex account issues to the appropriate personnel.
* Support consistent communication between customers and internal teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Previous experience in customer service, account support, order processing, or administrative coordination.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office and customer or order management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple customer requests and deadlines.
* Professional approach to problem-solving and customer relations.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in packaging, manufacturing, distribution, or product-based businesses.
* Familiarity with purchase orders, quotations, order fulfillment, and inventory processes.
* Experience using CRM, ERP, or order management software.
* Previous experience supporting business-to-business (B2B) customer accounts.

**Core Competencies**

* Customer relationship management
* Account coordination
* Packaging order processing
* Communication and follow-up
* Documentation accuracy
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Time management
* Problem-solving

Pay: $51,600.00 - $62,300.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

7ebb69f027dd13ea4740.title: Director of Customer Experience
7ebb69f027dd13ea4740.description:
**Description Overview**

The Director of Customer Experience leads one CX function across our Hanover, MD and Bremerton, WA teams and our offshore associates, setting the service standard for every customer interaction. You will move our help desk to HubSpot Service Hub, coach the team, and shift us from closing tickets on first reply to resolving them. You will also use AI to cut avoidable contacts, own complaints end to end, and give the business a data-backed view of what customers are telling us.

You will report to the Chief Operating Officer and supervise roughly 11 people, including two on-site CX leads and the offshore team.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Lead one CX function across three locations**

* Run the MD, WA and offshore teams as one function with a single standard, set of metrics and playbook.
* Own the Painful Pleasures storefront experience and its hand-off to the help desk.
* Own coverage, staffing and quality targets; hire, onboard and retain the team.
* Own the sales assistant desk and order entry so field reps can focus on customers.

**Deliver a premium standard of service**

* Define premium service for each customer type and build it into targets, tone and escalation paths.
* Own the customer side of returns, repairs, replacements and lost shipments, and turn executive escalations into process fixes.

**Lead the HubSpot Service Hub rollout for the team**

* Own the Service Hub rollout for CX, from acceptance criteria and training through adoption.

**Coach and develop the team**

* Run a regular coaching cadence and build the CX onboarding and skills program with the BAA Sales Academy and L&D.

**Use AI to make the work better**

* Use AI for routing, tagging, first-response drafts and knowledge base upkeep, with a human on decisions affecting a customer's money or order and within BAA's AI governance.

**Own complaints and complaint/feedback reporting**

* Own the complaints process across every brand, site and channel, from logging to resolution, with clear accountability and response commitments.
* Run root-cause review on complaints and feedback, track corrective actions with Operations, Fulfillment, Repairs, Product and Sales, and report monthly to leadership.
* Own social feedback and reviews across all brands and marketplaces: working with Marketing and the brand social teams.

**Be the voice of the customer**

* Report weekly and monthly on service health and contact drivers, and take fixes for avoidable contacts to Operations, Fulfillment, Product and Sales.
* Define the rep-to-CX hand-off so orders, quotes and account questions land in CX the first time.
* Share a daily customer-voice recap with product and brand teams; other duties as assigned.

**SKILLS****:**

* Hands-on experience implementing or migrating a help desk or CRM platform (HubSpot Service Hub, Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud or similar) as the business owner.
* Proven coaching ability, including developing front-line leads into managers.
* Practical use of AI in a service setting, with a clear view of where a person must stay in the loop.
* Process-improvement discipline: finding the root cause of avoidable contacts and fixing it with Operations, Fulfillment and Sales.
* Experience owning a formal complaints process, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions and reporting to leadership.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPI):**

**First 30 days**

* Meet the team and baseline first response, resolution time and backlog by brand.
* Join the HubSpot Service Hub project as CX owner.

**First 60 days**

* Publish one service standard and move to close-on-resolution.
* Sign off HubSpot acceptance criteria.

**First 90 days**

* Deliver the first monthly service health and complaints reports.
* Complete HubSpot testing and training.

**First 365 days**

* One service standard across every brand and site, with same-business-day first response.
* Backlog cleared and cases closed on resolution.
* HubSpot Service Hub live and adopted, with targets set with your leader in Q1.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS****:**

**Required**

* 8+ years in customer experience, customer service or support operations, including 4+ years leading managers or team leads.
* Experience running a multi-site or distributed service team, including offshore associates, in a B2B or omnichannel ecommerce business.
* A track record of measurably improving first response time, resolution time, backlog and customer satisfaction, and of being accountable for those numbers at the executive level.
* Bachelor's degree in business, communications or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a house-of-brands or distribution environment with NetSuite as the system of record, or with a retail storefront alongside a help desk.
* CCXP or similar CX certification; Lean, Six Sigma or comparable process training.
* Familiarity with the tattoo, piercing, PMU or professional beauty industries.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Remote within the US, with periodic travel Maryland and Washington state (approximately 20–25%).
* Prolonged computer work; able to safely access warehouse, storefront and operations areas and lift up to 25 pounds.

c4277e8a6c2adbf534ba.title: Associate Director, ITSM Process Owner
c4277e8a6c2adbf534ba.description:
**Job Summary**

Otsuka seeks an IT service management leader who makes disciplined ways of working an enabler of reliable technology, better experiences, and business value. This role will strengthen IT-wide accountability while helping teams work effectively across organizational and supplier boundaries.

  

The Associate Director owns the purpose, design, controls, measures, adoption, and improvement of assigned ITSM practices. The role provides functional direction and operational oversight for vendor resources supporting assigned ITSM processes, including setting priorities, coordinating work assignments, reviewing deliverables, monitoring capacity and service commitments. Platform and service owners remain accountable for their services; process managers and delivery teams execute the practices. The ServiceNow platform owner retains accountability for the platform roadmap, architecture, technical delivery, and platform operations. This role defines process requirements and acceptance criteria and jointly prioritizes enabling capabilities.

Core responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  
  

**IT-Wide Practice Ownership and Service Discipline**

* Lead the execution, adoption, and continuous improvement of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Service Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Service Configuration Management practices across IT." Establish clear interfaces with release, deployment, asset, monitoring and event, and supplier management practices.

* Apply ITIL V4 and ITIL V5 concepts, as well as Agile approaches, to create value through integrated practices and value streams, not isolated process compliance. Address people and organization, information and technology, partners and suppliers, and workflows together.

* Serve as an ambassador for the ITSM practice to the IT Service Owners. Promote best practices, communicate their value and engagement pathways, and gather stakeholder feedback to improve adoption, accessibility, service quality, and user experience in partnership with accountable service owners.

* Recommend enhancements to practice standards, procedures, controls, roles, and performance measures in partnership with IT leadership and service owners. Establish named execution owners across internal teams and suppliers; maintain applicable SOPs and Work Processes and review them periodically with IT and Global Quality

* Strengthen incident prioritization, escalation, major incident communications, and learning reviews. Ensure Problem Management addresses recurring and material failures through evidence-based investigation, known errors, workarounds, and verified corrective action.

* Advance risk-tiered Change Enablement, with proportionate assessment, authorization, scheduling, emergency handling, and review. Support appropriate standard changes and delivery automation without weakening accountability or bypassing controls.

* Set practical standards for request fulfillment, reusable knowledge, service configuration information, and service-level measurement. Work with accountable data and service owners to improve information quality, dependency visibility, and end-to-end support.

* Monitor adherence to ITSM practices, identify risks and improvement opportunities, and provide recommendations to leadership on corrective actions.
* Integrate applicable security, privacy, quality, validation, records, and audit requirements with Information Security, Quality, Compliance, and delivery stakeholders. Simplify controls where possible without compromising required evidence or risk treatment.
  

  

**Service Introduction, Performance and Continual Improvement**

* Lead and coordinate service introduction and operational readiness activities to support successful deployment of new and enhanced services. Partner with delivery leaders and platform and service owners to build operational requirements into design and delivery, rather than adding them immediately before go-live.

* Define proportionate readiness and acceptance criteria for ownership, support and escalation, service levels, monitoring, configuration and asset information, knowledge, capacity, resilience, recovery, security, training, and lifecycle support. Coordinate evidence and handoffs with accountable delivery and service owners.

* Make readiness gaps, residual risks, remediation commitments, and acceptance decisions explicit.

* Establish outcome-oriented measures and service reviews that expose recurring incidents, change-related disruption, restoration performance, request quality, knowledge usefulness, readiness gaps, and user experience. Challenge favorable dashboards when underlying evidence or service outcomes do not support them.
  

  

**Influence, ServiceNow Partnership and AI-Enabled Transformation**

* Lead an evidence-based improvement roadmap using baselines, value-stream analysis, stakeholder feedback, and practice capability assessments. Prioritize improvements by business value, risk, effort, and capacity; verify sustained benefits rather than closing actions on activity alone.

* Build commitment across IT leaders, platform and service owners, delivery teams, and suppliers through consultation, facilitation, negotiation, coaching, and clear escalation. Establish communities of practice and targeted enablement that make disciplined execution easier to adopt.

* Partner with the ServiceNow platform owner to translate practice needs into prioritized requirements, user stories, data standards, reporting, and acceptance criteria. Validate process outcomes and adoption while respecting platform architecture, configuration, release, and investment governance.

* . Identify, evaluate, and support implementation of AI-enabled and automated solutions that enhance ITSM effectiveness and user experience. Identify and evaluate opportunities such as assisted triage, knowledge creation and retrieval, trend analysis, and decision support; simplify the underlying work before automating it.

* Define human review, escalation, override, traceability, and quality checks for AI-enabled workflows with the platform owner and relevant control functions. Validate outputs and measure benefits and failure modes; retain accountable human judgment for material service, change, risk, and exception decisions.
  

**Qualifications**

Knowledge / Experience and Skills:

* **8+ years of progressive IT experience with demonstrated experience leading ITSM process improvement, service governance, or operational excellence initiatives** Demonstrated success establishing or materially improving ITSM discipline beyond a single team, with evidence of sustained adoption, stronger controls, reduced service disruption, or improved customer outcomes.

* Deep applied knowledge of ITIL 4 practices and working knowledge of ITIL (Version 5), including value creation, integrated digital product and service management, continual improvement, and responsible AI-enabled transformation.

* Substantial practical experience in Incident and Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and Change Enablement, with working breadth across requests, knowledge, configuration, service levels, and continual improvement.

* Experience governing service introduction and operational readiness across project, product, platform, and service teams; able to establish durable ownership and proportionate acceptance criteria.

* Experience leading in outsourced or multi-supplier environments, resolving cross-boundary ownership gaps, and translating service-level and process evidence into corrective action with accountable owners.

* Strong analytical capability: interprets operational data, tests data quality, distinguishes symptoms from systemic causes, and defines measures that connect practice performance to service and business outcomes.

* Demonstrated organizational change capability, including stakeholder analysis, facilitation, negotiation, coaching, communication, and reinforcement of new ways of working.

* Functional fluency in ServiceNow ITSM workflows, reporting & dashboarding, knowledge, and configuration information; able to define requirements and acceptance criteria with the platform owner. Platform development or administration is not the primary purpose of this role.

* Executive communication and matrix leadership: earns credibility with technical and business stakeholders, makes trade-offs clear, secures commitments without direct authority, and escalates constructively when alignment cannot be achieved.

* Experience evaluating AI-enabled or automated service workflows, including business value, data quality, human oversight, operational risk, and measurable adoption; hands-on transformation delivery is preferred.

* Sound human judgment: weighs evidence, business impact, uncertainty, and risk; recognizes when standard workflows or AI recommendations are insufficient and brings decisions to the appropriate accountable owner.

* Experience in a regulated life sciences or similarly controlled environment is preferred, including familiarity with audit evidence, quality requirements, and applicable computerized-system controls.

* Customer-focused: connects ITSM discipline to reliable services, usable experiences, and business value rather than administrative compliance alone.

* Accountable and persistent: establishes clear commitments, follows through, and verifies that improvements resolve the underlying issue.

* Curious and pragmatic: questions assumptions, learns from evidence, and adapts frameworks to context without unnecessary bureaucracy.

* Collaborative and influential: listens to understand, builds shared ownership, handles disagreement respectfully, and coaches others toward durable change.

* Ethical and candid: reports inconvenient facts accurately, challenges unsupported conclusions, and preserves transparency and accountable human decisions.

* Composed and resilient: exercises proportionate judgment under pressure and balances urgency with control, learning, and service continuity.

* Able to develop process managers and practitioners through practical guidance, coaching, and targeted training.

* Systems thinker: understands dependencies across people, practices, information, technology, and suppliers; improves end-to-end flow rather than optimizing one team at another team's expense.

* Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams and communicating effectively across organizational and cultural boundaries.

* Travel approximately 5-10%, based on business needs.
  

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience.

Advanced education in technology management, organizational change, operations, or business is advantageous but not required.  



**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

**Statement Regarding Job Recruiting Fraud Scams**

At Otsuka we take security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please be aware individuals may approach you and falsely present themselves as our employees or representatives. They may use this false pretense to try to gain access to your personal information or acquire money from you by offering fictitious employment opportunities purportedly on our behalf.

Please understand, Otsuka will **never** ask for financial information of any kind or for payment of money during the job application process. We do not require any financial, credit card or bank account information and/or any payment of any kind to be considered for employment. We will also not offer you money to buy equipment, software, or for any other purpose during the job application process. If you are being asked to pay or offered money for equipment fees or some other application processing fee, even if claimed you will be reimbursed, this is not Otsuka. These claims are fraudulent and you are strongly advised to exercise caution when you receive such an offer of employment.

Otsuka will also never ask you to download a third-party application in order to communicate about a legitimate job opportunity. 5907f6c6908c9ef4d54c.description:
**Job Description:**

Are you someone who understands banking operations and enjoys helping others learn? Do you have experience working with **Time Deposits (CD and IRA), Safe Deposit Box or New Accounts** and want to take that knowledge beyond the branch?

CSI is looking for an **Implementation Specialist - Time Deposits & Safe Deposit Box**, to support financial institutions through core conversions and implementations. This is a great opportunity for someone with banking experience who wants to grow into a more technical, client-facing role while helping banks successfully transition to CSI solutions.

**What You’ll Do**

As an Implementation Specialist, you'll be involved in client conversions from start to finish, with a primary focus on **Time Deposits and Safe Deposit Boxes, correspondent balancing, and general ledger unposted balancing.**

You’ll serve as a client-facing resource throughout the conversion process, helping ensure tasks are completed accurately and on schedule while training bank employees on their new systems and processes.

In this role, you will:

* Support implementations and conversions involving Time Deposits and Safe Deposit Boxes
* Balance Time Deposit and Safe Deposit Box activity and reconcile related control accounts
* Assist with balancing activities involving general ledger accounts, ACH activity, cash letters, and correspondent accounts
* Balance and repair unposted general ledger items
* Understand how CDs and IRAs work throughout their lifecycle, including account activity, distributions, and related banking processes
* Work directly with bank employees during conversions, helping them locate accounts, understand system functionality, and complete balancing activities
* Train client employees on CSI solutions and processes related to Time Deposits and other assigned products
* Serve as a consistent client-facing point of contact throughout assigned portions of the conversion
* Monitor assigned tasks and timelines to help keep conversions on schedule
* Partner with specialists supporting DDA, loans, cards, project management, and other areas of the conversion
* Stay current on CSI products and enhancements to provide effective client training and implementation support

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must Have**

* At least 2 years of relevant work experience
* Banking or financial institution experience
* Working knowledge of CDs and/or IRAs
* Experience that may include teller, frontline banking, new accounts, deposit operations, or similar banking responsibilities
* Understanding of how deposit accounts and transactions move through a financial institution
* Strong communication and customer service skills

* Ability to work directly with bank employees and explain processes in a clear, approachable way
* Basic Microsoft Excel skills, including copying/pasting information and using basic formulas
* Ability and willingness to travel as required for client conversions
* Education or job knowledge equivalent to college or university undergraduate education

**What Will Help You Stand Out**

* Back-office or deposit operations experience
* Strong IRA knowledge, including experience supporting IRA account activity and distributions
* Experience balancing deposit accounts, control accounts, or general ledger activity
* Experience with ACH, cash letters, or correspondent balancing
* Previous involvement with a core banking conversion or system implementation
* Experience training bank employees or customers
* Familiarity with CSI solutions or NuPoint

**Travel Requirements**

* Approximately **minimum 50%** travel, based on business needs and the conversion schedule
* Travel is typically Sunday through Friday during onsite conversions
* Some conversions may require up to two consecutive weeks onsite
* Saturday work is required during conversions to support balancing and go-live activities
* Travel frequency will vary based on conversion volume, bank size, and project complexity
* Ability to travel regularly and work a flexible schedule during conversion periods is required

**Why This Role?**

If you’ve built your banking knowledge at a branch, in new accounts, or within deposit operations and are ready for something different, this role gives you the opportunity to take that experience directly to CSI clients.

You’ll learn the implementation and conversion process, work with different financial institutions, expand your knowledge of banking technology, and become part of the team responsible for helping banks successfully transition to CSI.

As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit www.csiweb.com

CSI provides rewarding and challenging career opportunities for our employees. When determining your pay, we consider various factors such as your skills, qualifications, experience and location. Along with a competitive salary, this position includes eligibility for incentive awards based on both individual and business performance. We also offer a comprehensive range of benefits. To learn more about our benefits, visit: Benefits Summary

CSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email us at recruiter@csiweb.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

98e56cb54d3eeef67b96.description:
**Vacation Coordinator – Remote**
=================================

We are seeking a Remote Vacation Coordinator to assist clients with planning, organizing, and managing their vacation arrangements from the initial consultation through the completion of their trip. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented, service-focused individual who enjoys coordinating travel logistics, researching vacation options, and helping clients create enjoyable and well-organized travel experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Communicate with clients to identify their vacation preferences, travel dates, budgets, and specific needs
* Research and recommend vacation destinations, resorts, hotels, cruises, transportation, and activities based on client preferences
* Coordinate and manage vacation reservations, including accommodations, transportation, excursions, and other travel services
* Develop organized vacation itineraries and provide clients with important travel details and documentation
* Assist clients throughout the vacation planning process by answering questions, providing updates, and addressing concerns
* Manage reservation modifications, cancellations, and schedule changes as needed
* Maintain accurate client information, reservation records, and travel documentation
* Monitor important booking deadlines, payment schedules, and travel requirements
* Follow up with clients after their vacations to gather feedback and support future travel planning needs

**Qualifications**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a commitment to providing excellent customer service
* Excellent organizational abilities and attention to detail
* Ability to coordinate multiple vacation arrangements and manage competing priorities
* Comfortable using online research tools, booking platforms, and digital communication systems
* Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage responsibilities in a remote setting
* Reliable internet access and an appropriate home workspace
* Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, travel planning, or administrative coordination is beneficial but not required

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote opportunity with flexible scheduling
* Access to travel industry resources, booking platforms, and professional training
* Ongoing guidance and support to develop travel planning and client service skills
* Opportunities to specialize in vacation destinations and travel experiences
* The ability to work directly with clients and coordinate personalized vacation arrangements
* A supportive, travel-focused professional community

008e3d89b4591c497293.title: Director of Activities & Transportation (Senior Living)
008e3d89b4591c497293.description:
**About Discovery Management Group**

Discovery Management Group leads one of the nation’s most purpose-driven and people-centered senior living organizations, managing and enhancing senior living communities across the United States. With a focus on operational excellence, lifestyle personalization, and culture-driven leadership, we proudly serve residents and families with more than 15,000 units nationwide and growing.

As part of one of the largest senior living families in the U.S., our communities have earned Great Place to Work® certifications from 2022–2027. At Discovery Management Group, purpose guides our work, culture fuels our success, and growth defines our future. We continually aspire and invest in learning and development opportunities that support our team members’ professional growth, ensuring every team member has the tools to build a meaningful and rewarding career.

**Discover Your Purpose with Us at Discovery Commons Newark!**

As **Director of Activities & Transportation**, you’ll play an essential role in enriching the lives of seniors, creating meaningful connections, and making a difference every single day.

  

**Your Role:**

As the **Director of Activities & Transportation**, your role includes developing and leading a vibrant lifestyle program that promotes health, wellness, active aging, engagement, and growth for residents across all levels of service.

**Position Highlights:**

* Status: FULL TIME
* Schedule: Traditional leadership workweek with flexibility required based on business and operational needs that includes Manager on Duty hours as well as on call for emergency situations
* Location: Newark, DE
* Rate of Pay: $70k + 10% Annual Performance Target Bonus
* Travel: TBD

**Why You'll Love This Community:**

Welcome to Discovery Commons Newark, where thoughtful support and genuine hospitality help residents feel comfortable from the start. Mornings may begin with a favorite breakfast, followed by a creative program, a friendly conversation, or time spent enjoying a familiar interest. Each day offers opportunities for connection without losing the comfort of an individual routine.

Families exploring senior living Newark, DE, can find Assisted Living and SHINE® Memory Care in one welcoming community. Residents are known for who they are, from the stories they enjoy sharing to the personal preferences that make each day feel familiar and fulfilling.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Plan, schedule, and facilitate lifestyle programs that provide physical, intellectual, social, emotional, and spiritual opportunities for residents
* Organize and lead holiday celebrations, special events, and mixed-group activities that foster connection and community spirit
* Prepare, publish, and distribute the monthly activity calendar and community newsletter
* Maintain a robust public relations program, building partnerships with outside organizations, service groups, and independent contractors
* Oversee resident facing technology to ensure team members and resident are trained and the information is kept up to date
* Provide leadership to Activities Coordinators, supervising daily operations and ensuring program excellence across service levels
* Maintain compliance with federal, state, and local regulations related to senior living programming
* Monitor participation and satisfaction through surveys, quality assurance tools, and resident feedback to continuously improve programming
* Manage Celebrations department budget, including purchasing and maintaining equipment and supplies
* Organize and oversee the community library, communication displays, and resident information boards
* Represent the community in internal and external meetings, delivering engaging presentations to residents, families, and partners
* Oversee community transportation services, including coordinating schedules and ensuring safe, reliable transportation for residents.
* Operate the community bus or other company vehicles as needed to transport residents to appointments, shopping, outings, events, and other local destinations.
* Ensure community vehicles and transportation activities are managed in accordance with company policies and applicable safety requirements.

**Qualifications:**

* Associate degree in Recreation, Education, Gerontology, Social Work, Adult Education, or a related field preferred
* Three to five years of experience in lifestyle programming or resident services within senior living or a related field
* At least two years of supervisory/management experience
* Strong leadership, organizational, and team-building skills
* Wellness certificate a plus (ICAA Leadership in Wellness)
* Valid driver’s license and ability to meet company requirements for operating community vehicles and transporting residents.
* Ability to plan and execute diverse programming that meets a wide range of resident interests and abilities
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage residents, staff, and external partners
* Creative, resourceful, and resident-focused approach to program development

**Why Join Us**

**Discovery Senior Living Earned Coveted Great Place to Work Certification for 2025-2027!**

A large part of what makes Discovery different from other companies in this industry is our willingness to embrace change. At Discovery Senior Living, we are constantly challenging how we are doing things to ensure the lifestyle we are offering our residents is absolutely the greatest value proposition in the marketplace. It’s just as important to us that the environment and culture for our team members are constantly refreshed. In addition, embracing and even encouraging change brings a never-ending supply of new energy to our business and our culture. That energy translates to other far-reaching positive impacts on our residents as well as our team members.

Find out what makes working at Discovery unique in the world of senior living. Discover Your Purpose!

**Our Culture & Values**

So often, what brings people together is deeply rooted in who we are and what we stand for. And at Discovery Senior Living, we’re unified by certain, core values, which we call our “Pillars of Excellence.” They make up the fabric of our company, and include TEAMWORK, INTEGRITY, PERFORMANCE, ACCOUNTABILITY, COMPASSION, HARD WORK and CREATIVITY.

Individually, they are our virtues, and together, they make up a roadmap which helps us foster innovation and success.

**Benefits You’ll Enjoy**

For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive pay, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, paid time off and holidays, a 401(k) with employer match, paid training and career growth opportunities, wellness-related benefits, and additional support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. EOE D/V

**A Note to Applicants**

This job description outlines the general nature and level of responsibilities for this role and is not an exhaustive list of all duties. Qualified individuals with disabilities, as defined by the ADA, must be able to perform the essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation, as determined on a case-by-case basis.

**Agency Policy**

We do not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies. Please refrain from contacting hiring managers directly.

**Employment Scam Warning**

We only post jobs on our official careers site and accept applications through that platform. We do not conduct interviews via text or social media or ask for personal or banking information.

**Regulatory Compliance & Background Screening**

Discovery Senior Living complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and regulatory requirements governing hiring practices, background screening, and workforce eligibility. Employment may be contingent upon successful completion of state-mandated and/or federally required background screenings, which may include criminal history checks, fingerprint-based screening, Level 2 background screening, registry verification, and other screenings required for healthcare and senior living roles with direct or indirect resident access.

Certain positions may be subject to additional requirements under federal programs, including CMS, Medicare, and Medicaid regulations, as well as state-specific licensing or regulatory agencies. Screening requirements vary by role and jurisdiction, and candidates must meet all applicable standards as a condition of employment. These measures support regulatory compliance and help maintain a safe, secure environment for residents, families, and team members.

Employment in Florida is contingent upon completion of a Level 2 background screening in accordance with Florida AHCA requirements. Applicants will be required to complete fingerprinting and background screening through the AHCA Clearinghouse. For more information, please visit: https://info.flclearinghouse.com.

215d5c0b000bbf0fa2d6.title: Receptionist
215d5c0b000bbf0fa2d6.description:
**Front Desk Receptionist / Scheduling Coordinator**

We are seeking a friendly and capable Front Desk Receptionist to join our busy physical therapy office in Jackson, NJ.

This is a fast-paced, hands-on position for someone who enjoys staying active throughout the day. Our office has a steady flow of patients, frequent phone calls, and a constantly changing appointment schedule. Cancellations and rescheduling create openings throughout the day, so we need someone proactive who will work diligently to keep the schedule full.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Welcoming patients and managing the front desk professionally
* Answering incoming calls promptly and courteously
* Scheduling, confirming, canceling, and rescheduling appointments
* Filling openings created by cancellations or schedule changes
* Contacting patients who may be available for open appointment times
* Managing a busy and sometimes complicated appointment schedule
* Balancing phone calls, patient check-ins, and scheduling needs
* Communicating clearly with patients, therapists, and office staff
* Staying organized and accurate while handling multiple tasks

**The ideal candidate is:**

* Friendly, pleasant, and professional
* Proactive and motivated to keep the schedule full
* Comfortable working in a busy, constantly changing environment
* An excellent multitasker with strong attention to detail
* Dependable, organized, and able to take initiative
* Confident communicating with patients by telephone and in person
* Comfortable using computers and learning scheduling software

This is not a slow or routine front-desk position. It is a dynamic role for someone who enjoys solving scheduling challenges, taking initiative, and helping a busy office operate efficiently.

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

0b61f628293aabe4d045.description:
**Overview**

As a Human Resources Payroll Coordinator, you’ll keep payroll and employee records accurate while supporting essential human resources operations. You’ll coordinate payroll processing, respond to employee questions, and handle confidential information with care. Your work will connect payroll administration with HR systems, compliance, and employee support.

Your impact: Accurate payroll and timely HR support help employees receive clear answers and enable teams to manage workforce needs effectively.

**Responsibilities**

* Process payroll and maintain employee data in human resources information systems (HRIS), such as Workday, ADP, Paychex, Dayforce, or similar platforms.
* Review data entries and Excel analyses; resolve discrepancies and support payroll reporting.
* Assist with benefits administration, employee orientation, recruiting, talent acquisition, and applicant tracking systems (ATS).
* Support employee relations, performance management, employee evaluations, training and development, and workers’ compensation administration.
* Maintain personnel records and support regulatory compliance, including applicable employment and labor laws, Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), and Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) requirements.

**Skills**

* Required: Payroll processing, payroll or HR department experience, human resources management, data entry, Microsoft Office, Excel data analysis, communication, and confidential information handling.
* Familiarity with HRIS and HR systems; experience with Oracle HCM, Kronos, UltiPro, Paylocity, Ceridian, PeopleSoft, or SAP SuccessFactors is useful.
* Knowledge of employment law, HR legal compliance, benefits administration, employee relations, and personnel administration.
* Additional HR exposure may include talent management, workforce management, HR sourcing, interviewing, contracts, affirmative action planning, succession planning, organization design, strategic planning, change management, project management, and conflict management.
* Recruiting tools such as Lever, Taleo, iCIMS, Kenexa BrassRing, and Salesforce, or experience with social media management, are helpful; not every listed platform or specialty is required.

Pay: $28.66 - $34.52 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
