8a8ad7536356aaa1cb64.description:
Evergreen Virtual Academy (EVA) is an independently managed, public charter school for Kindergarten through 12th grade students in Oregon. When you join the team at EVA, you join a team of dedicated professionals working all over the state in a virtual environment to ensure the success of our families and students meet their educational needs and goals. EVA is authorized by the North Bend School District and accredited through Cognia.

**Important information about this posting:**

* Current grade band placement is expected to be High School.
* Employees of EVA are ***required to reside in Oregon***
* Please include at least one current and/or recent supervisor on references to be considered
* To be considered for an interview, you will need to upload a completed ***Performance Task*** to your application. You will use THIS DATA to fill in the highlighted sections of THIS PERFORMANCE TASK. If you are unable to upload, you can send it to hhart@evergreenvirtual.org
* As per our CBA, steps on our salary scale are not aligned directly with years of experience. Most can expect to receive half their years of experience, plus up to 2 additional steps. To determine your salary placement please refer to details on page 37 & 38 of the CBA.
* Special Education Teachers receive a stipend in addition to the base pay. You can find stipend information below the salary scale in the CBA. Stipend is included in the salary range.
* EVA pays the employee 6% PERS contribution and employer contributions toward health insurance premiums can be found in the CBA.
* This is a virtual position with some required in person events and/or PD. For additional information, please refer to the Events section of the CBA
* The workday is 8am-4pm M-F

**Job** **Summary**

The Special Education Teacher is a highly qualified, state certified educator responsible for delivering Specially Designed Instruction in an online environment. Special Education Teachers provide instruction, support, and guidance, manage the learning process, and focus on students’ individual needs. Special Education Teachers monitor student progress through the learning management system, and they actively work closely with students and parents/Learning Coaches to advance each student’s learning toward established goals. Special Education Teachers typically work from home but must travel occasionally throughout the year to various school functions, for state testing and as may be otherwise required by the school.

**Essential** **Duties****,** **Responsibilities****, and Abilities**  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

***Instructional******:***

* Takes ownership for student’s academic progress and attendance, communicating high expectations and showing active interest in student’s achievement
* Conducts live Synchronous Teaching for Specially Designed Instruction and when necessary, based on student need, Modified Curriculum courses.
* Asynchronously supports objectives, including composing/sending emails, planning class objectives, preparing learning plans, and using data to determine student needs.
* Team Teach/Push-into in General Education classrooms to support IEP students either on case management caseload or on assigned SDI caseload.
* Supports General Education Teachers in modifying assignments for all assigned students
* Ensures all assigned students are accessing their outlined IEP accommodations in the classroom through consistent communication with GE Teachers.
* Attend GE classrooms for observations and evaluation of student needs in the classroom as needed.
* Prepares students for high stakes standardized tests and school-based assessments by ensuring appropriate accommodations are utilized based on the nature of the student’s disability and needs.
* Maintains grade book and submits grades and required student work ensuring student academic honesty and integrity. HS Resource Elective Course, as well as any Modified Curriculum courses taught.
* Makes placement and promotion decisions by generating formal and informal reports regarding student progress, alerting administrators to concerns about student performance and progress.
* Maintains progress monitoring on all assigned student IEP goals with a minimum of 5 data points through the school year. Reviews this data and hold’s immediate IEPs to re-evaluation student needs for those not making expected progress toward goals throughout the school year.
* Reports progress to all IEP goals of assigned students at the end of each semester and at the annual IEP.
* Collaborates with local/regional/ national teams and instructional coaches regarding instruction, resources, interventions, and data-driven decision making.
* Receptive and responsive to coaching from administrators and instructional coaches on a regular basis.
* Under guidance from principal, augments course content according to prescribed policies and procedures using appropriate asynchronous and synchronous tools.
* Use of effective presentation skills when addressing students, staff, parents, and the community, including appropriate vocabulary and examples, clear and legible visuals, and articulate and audible speech.
* Promote high standards and expectations for all students and staff for academic performance and responsibility for behavior.

***Case Management and Compliance******:***

* Special Education IEP Case Management for all assigned students.
* Holds all IEPs within legal timeframes for assigned students
* Intake IEPs held as soon as possible, within 10 days of enrollment whenever possible
* IEPs held at least annually
* Re-Eligibility meetings held at least tri-annually
* Initial Eligibility meetings held within 60 days of signed Evaluation Plan
* Ensures all ODE General Supervision items are in compliance on IEPs for all assigned students
* Gathers all required compliance documents for assigned students
* Orders Related Services and assessments immediately upon receiving the IEP or consent
* Ensures assessors have all the necessary information from the school to conduct a comprehensive evaluation (i.e., previous reports, academic data, classroom information, classroom observation) for all assigned students being evaluated
* Plans for IEP meetings at least 30 days in advance to ensure staff and parent attendance (exceptions for emergency situations)
* Schedules IEP meetings with all required and optional participants, communicating with each participant as to what their role will be and what they may need to prepare
* Conducts Eligibility planning and has completed File Reviews ready at least 60 school days prior to the Re-Eligibility due date to ensure compliance timelines are met should additional testing be required
* Uploads and maintains all procedurally required documents into IEP software system
* Uploads and maintains all IEP paperwork in EVA’s student records system within expected timelines while following procedural outline of documents and naming conventions
* Follows ODE Best Practices for writing IEP’s guide
* Reports student progress to goals at the end of each semester and at annual IEP
* Provides Summary of Progress for assigned students upon graduation
* Completes Exit Surveys and Follow Up Interviews for graduated EVA students
* Completes classroom observations of initial and re-evaluation evaluation students to share with assessors
* Conducts standardized academic evaluations as requested and needed
* Follows EVA’s Special Education Procedural Manual and direction from Director of Special Programs & Alternative Pathways / Dean of Special Education for all other procedural and compliance items
* Adhere to Oregon school law, State Board of Education rules and regulations, Board of Education policies and regulations, school regulations and procedures, and contractual obligations

***Functional and Life Skills Teacher Specific Responsibilities******:***

* Provides Functional Academics, Life Skills, Transition Services, and Specially Designed Instruction to all assigned students and those who would be appropriately placed in this level of support
* Teaches Modified curriculum to assigned students on caseload requiring such
* Modifies assignments and supports General Education Teachers in modifying assignments for assigned students
* Supports EVA administrators with school information sessions and PD for staff pertaining to their expertise
* May be assigned students with high needs who would be best served by this teacher, but who do not meet ID Eligibility

***Communication and Relationship Building:***

* Establishes and maintains positive rapport with families and regularly communicates with students and learning coaches/parents.
* Supports students and learning coaches with the set-up and maintenance of their learning environment including basic computer troubleshooting.
* Understands how both diverse and unique characteristics of students and their families impact required support.
* Works collaboratively with other staff to ensure that all students are successfully progressing through the program, that parents have a central point of contact, and that tasks are distributed among the stakeholders.
* Contact students and/or learning coaches that need extra support and guidance.
* Responds to students, parents, and colleagues in timely manner.
* Conduct regular conferences with parents/responsible adults and students to assess each child’s progress, learning style, and any other academic, social, or developmental issues.
* Organize service-learning opportunities that support student development.
* Attend grade band staff meetings, Special Programs staff meetings, assigned PLC’s, and review all school newsletters/emails when received
* Represent the school and district at community, state, and professional meetings and conferences.
* Maintain appropriate levels of communication with the General Education staff and other Special Programs Coordinators regarding shared students.
* Ensure all General Education Teachers and all appropriate staff have been provided with the most updated IEP/IEP-At-A-Glance for all assigned students.
* Inform all appropriate staff and update documents for any changes to student diploma type
* Collaborate with General Education Teachers regarding development and planning of lessons to ensure scaffolding, including instructional strategies, for student learning styles and skills.
* Contacts assigned families for schoolwide initiatives such as universal assessments, Re-Registration status, Summer School participation, etc.
* Meet with Principal/Dean/Director as needed or on scheduled basis for compliance assurance items.
* Support EVA administrators with school information sessions and PD presentations as needed.
* Facilitates student clubs, monthly community and social events as needed.

***Other Essential Functions******:***

* Work with support staff, coordinators/specialists, and administrators to support students, collect and analyze data.
* Maintain a tracker to monitor progress of students.
* Maintain a log of work completed and hours for final submission.
* Travel for in person events, PD, and testing
* Participate in committees as required
* Helps with any enrollment retention efforts as directed
* Pedagogical knowledge of content being taught and ability to apply critical thinking.
* Knowledge of state content standards and ability to align those with the curriculum.
* Ability to embrace change/ adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes.
* Ability to problem solve independently and have a high level of organization.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office 365
* Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* This job has no supervisory responsibilities

**Qualifications**

***Minimum Required Qualifications:***

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Six (6) months teaching experience OR Equivalent combination of education and experience
* Meet requirements for Highly Qualified Teacher (HQT) in subject area by TSPC
* Ability to clear required background check

***Certificates and Licenses****:*

* TSPC Special Education Teaching License

***Other Desired*** ***Qualifications:***

* Experience working with proposed age group and disability severity level
* Experience working in a virtual classroom
* Experience with various online platforms, such as Canvas

**Physical/Mental Demands**

The employee is required to possess excellent communication skills, both written and oral. Human relations and communication skills are necessary to handle frequent personal and telephone inquiries received from students/families, administrators, teachers, classified employees, and others. Work requests are often received which require immediate attention setting up conflicting priorities for timely response. Sound judgment and a pleasant attitude are required in stressful situations. The employee needs to be able to lift/move/carry materials, equipment or boxes weighing up to 30 pounds.

**Vice President, Ecommerce Client Services**

**ABOUT MPG**

Market Performance Group (MPG) is a leading end-to-end, strategy & services omnichannel commerce agency focused on creating the best PATH FORWARD — from market strategy to in-market reality — for today’s fastest-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers. Over the years, we’ve built a strong reputation as a trusted partner and valuable resource to a broad range of companies, from Fortune 500 to Private Equity, in categories that include health & wellness, food & beverage, home and hardlines. We revel in the opportunity to guide our clients on their path forward, building and activating strategies that ensure success. Everything we do is driven by our unrelenting commitment to leverage our deep operational experience, unparalleled omnichannel expertise, and industry relationships to drive performance in today’s dynamic omnichannel marketplace.

At MPG, we value our people and their contributions; they are critical to building the MPG Brand. Our leadership team has significant experience driving topline revenue and bottom-line profit, having held senior operating roles at leading CPG manufacturers and retailers. Our highly regarded, seasoned team of 400+ strategy and commercialization professionals brings strong operational experience and a collaborative approach. All team members are singularly focused on providing clients with pragmatic, real-world market approaches, built on the strong consumer, category and marketplace insights needed to create sustainable, profitable brand growth.

  

**Position Overview**

As MPG invests in senior client leadership to deepen client partnerships as we scale, MPG is hiring for the role of Vice President, Ecommerce Client Services, to own ecommerce service delivery, client satisfaction and revenue growth across MPG’s Amazon and Retail Media account teams

You will lead the leaders and teams who manage client relationships day to day, hold the executive relationship on our most important accounts, and be accountable for retention, satisfaction, account growth, and P&L performance. You will also contribute to MPG’s overall agency growth strategy and take part in preparing for and delivering pitches alongside our business development team.

Deep Amazon expertise is essential, whether your depth is in retail and operations, in media, or in both. Hans-on retail media network experience is valued, and expected for candidates whose depth is in media. You will provide strategic guidance and step into the details with the team when needed.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Client Leadership & Revenue Growth**

* + Own client satisfaction and retention across the account-facing teams, and set the standard for how MPG shows up for every ecommerce client

  + Serve as executive sponsor for MPG’s most important ecommerce client relationships, and personally manage a select set of accounts where senior presence matters most.

  + Oversee quarterly business reviews, client business plans, and spot risk and opportunity early, stepping in proactively where needed.

  + Grow the portfolio by earning renewals, expanded scope, and adoption of MPG capabilities, ensuring account teams act on growth opportunities and turn client needs into proposals, with Finance on scope, pricing, and profitability.

  + Manage the portfolio P&L in partnership with Finance, balancing growth, margin, and resourcing.

  + Partner with the business development team on pitches and RFP responses, serve as the senior client leader prospects meet, and ensure newly won clients are onboarded smoothly.

  

**Team Leadership**

* Lead a US-based team of 15 to 30 full-time employees, supported by an offshore team, including the senior leaders, directors, and managers responsible for client management.

* Set goals and standards, coach, build succession, and hire as the business grows, with staffing models that keep workloads healthy as we scale.

* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, and client-first thinking, where feedback flows in every direction.

* Invest in career growth through mentoring, clear progression paths, and a pipeline of talent including early-career hires.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, public relations, business, or a related field preferred
* 0–3 years of relevant experience, including internships, freelance work, campus organizations, or entry-level roles
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized with excellent attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities
* Professional and confident when communicating with clients and creators
* Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and the broader creator landscape
* Ability to take initiative, solve problems, and ask thoughtful questions
* Collaborative, adaptable, and excited to work in a fast-moving environment

**Success in Your First Year**

* Success will be measured by business results, supported by the health of our clients and our teams.
* Topline growth and EBITDA performance, for the ecommerce business and for MPG overall.

* Client satisfaction and retention across your portfolio, with a clear view of client health and early action on risk.

* Team satisfaction and retention, with leaders who are developing, aligned, and accountable.

  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience at the VP or executive level leading client teams and developing leaders, with 8-12+ years in Amazon, ecommerce, and retail media. Agency or managed services experience is preferred, and you understand the pace, client intensity, and commercial realities of agency life.

* P&L management experience strongly preferred, including forecasting, margin management, and resourcing for a client portfolio or business unit.

* Proven client management with brand leadership, including C-suite and VP-level stakeholders. You enjoy client engagement, build trust quickly, and stay close to the client’s business.

* Passion for business development. You enjoy helping win new clients and have helped prepare for and deliver pitches as part of a team. This is not a quota-carrying sales role.

* Deep, operational Amazon expertise in at least one of these areas: retail and operations (Vendor Central, Seller Central, content, inventory, and supply chain), or media and Retail Media (Amazon advertising and DSP, plus, for candidates whose depth is in media, hands-on experience with retail media networks such as Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, Instacart Ads, Kroger Precision Marketing, and Criteo). You will not be expected to manage accounts hands on keys, but you can dive in to support teams, from auditing an account to pressure-testing a plan.

* Strategic mindset. You connect client needs and market trends to MPG’s growth plans, track Amazon and Retail Media platform changes, and help shape how teams are structured, scaled, and equipped, including with AI

* Strong analytical fluency and executive presence, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations and represent MPG credibly to clients, prospects, and leadership.

  

**Who You Are**

Beyond the experience above, these qualities matter most to us, and we will explore them with real examples.

* Team-first leadership. You lead with humility, give credit generously, and take pride in developing others.

* Comfort with ambiguity. You thrive in an environment where you are empowered to make decisions, even with incomplete information, and bring clarity to teams and clients when the path is not obvious.

* Prioritization and focus. You manage many competing priorities at once, protect what matters most, and keep teams focused on it.

* Resilience. You stay steady, constructive, and solutions-focused when things get intense.

* Accountability. You own outcomes, good and bad, hold yourself and others to a high standard, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Candor with care. You give direct feedback and deliver hard messages to teams and clients with empathy and respect

  

**Compensation**

The expected base salary range for this position is $195,000-240,000 annually, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based bonuses and other compensation programs.

  

**Benefits**

MPG offers a generous package of health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, paid maternity/paternity leave and life insurance. Our compensation program provides market industry base salary, bonuses, and 401K. In addition to paid holidays, we reward an employee’s extra efforts through unlimited paid time off.

**Diversity and Inclusion**

MPG provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

We are committed to ensuring that Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEI&B) are at the foundation of our culture. Through DEI&B, we embrace the beauty in all of the unique qualities of our employees, communities and clients. MPG’s DEI&B efforts empower us to collectively reach our full potential by fueling innovation, connection, and growth. We recognize the value of having a diverse and engaged team. We are an organization driven by PEOPLE. Our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging was born from our core values. We believe that by leveraging the unique perspectives and experiences of our employees, MPG can unlock more comprehensive, innovative, and long-standing results for both our client and retailer partners. ad67e1f898e01b7f43a5.description:
**Introduction**
----------------

The Housing Resource Specialist will perform as a member of the Family Informed Resource Support Team (FIRST) within the Office of Case Management. This position will specifically be responsible for assisting families with addressing housing-related challenges and must have a working knowledge of housing assistance programs and supports in Delaware. FIRST embraces a family and youth engagement model and strives to identify creative solutions designed to build on family strengths and address their unique needs. FIRST works to discover community-based services through identification, outreach, and partnership building with local community providers. This position requires travel within the community to develop these services and partnerships.

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

Essential functions are fundamental, core functions common to all positions in the class series and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties for any one position in the class. Since class specifications are descriptive and not restrictive, incumbents can complete job duties of similar kind not specifically listed here.

* Provides services to advocate for health, safety and welfare or rights of clients and their families and assists them in obtaining needed services.
* Interviews clients and family members and/or professionals to gather personal, social and background information; works closely with the client and family to formulate a clear description of the client and family’s problems; identify the key forces which maintain the problems; discover resources and strengths available to the client and family to resolve the problems; and identify the blocks, if any, that prevent the client and family from resolving the problems without the intervention of the State agency.
* Determines eligibility for various social service programs offered by the agency or available in the community.
* In collaboration with the client and family, develops and implements service/treatment plans, outlining the goals and objectives to be accomplished, methods and techniques to be used, and anticipated results; helps the client and family to obtain community, social and/or therapeutic services and resources needed to accomplish plans and objectives.
* Conducts individual and group counseling sessions with clients and members of the family to aid in achieving satisfactory social development and adjustment to specific problems and situations.
* Assesses progress toward goals and makes recommendations on plans such as reclassification, discharge, aftercare, emergency protective placement in emergency or crisis situations, guardianship, petitions or options counseling.
* Prepares social histories, client progress reports, evaluation and discharge summaries, court reports or petitions; prepares and maintains a variety of records and files pertaining to clients assigned to caseload.
* Enforces court orders and conditions of community supervision as required. Attends court hearings and other judicial proceedings to answer questions, make recommendations and present progress reports regarding clients.
* May be called upon to intervene in crisis situations such as potential suicides, assault and battery against clients, and sexual abuse cases. May coordinate with law enforcement and other emergency staff if needed. May be required to isolate and/or physically restrain clients who are acting out.
* May be required to perform emergency duty which requires being on call for an assigned time period.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

*Professional health or human service work may include but is not limited to determining eligibility for and availability of community resources; assisting and connecting clients and their families to needed services; addressing family conflict and engaging crisis resolution; and evaluating progress towards goals.*

  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS for Master Family Service Specialist**

Applicants must have education, training and/or experience demonstrating competence in each of the following areas:
  
  
1. **Applicants must possess at least one of the following:**

  

* Three years' experience in professional health or human service work.

**OR**  
  

* Possession of an Associate's degree AND two years' experience in professional health or human service work.

**OR**  
  

* Possession of a Bachelor's degree or higher.

**In addition to the above requirement, applicants must meet all of the job requirements below:**

2. One year of experience in health or human services focusing on the safety and welfare of families such as identifying issues, barriers and goals; determining eligibility for and availability of community resources; assisting clients and their families in obtaining needed services; family conflict and crisis resolution and assessing progress towards goals.  
  

3. Two years' experience in case management such as assessing, planning, developing, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating options and services to meet an individual's human service needs.

**Additional Posting Information**
----------------------------------

This is a Casual/Seasonal position which is a non-pension eligible position without healthcare and/or other benefits.

**Conditions of Hire**
----------------------

Applicants will be asked to draft a writing sample.The purpose of this written exercise is to assess your writing skills for paragraph structure, grammar, punctuation, spelling, organization, clarity and thoroughness. Pre-employment Drug Testing: Upon a conditional offer, you must undergo pre-employment drug testing as part of the hiring process.

Criminal background check: A satisfactory criminal background check is required as a condition of hire. The recruiting agency may require the applicant to pay for the criminal background check as part of the conditional offer of hire.

All new hires are required to report to the Statewide New Employee Orientation (SNEO) on their first day of employment. Sessions are held at designated locations in Kent or New Castle County.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. The State of Delaware Executive Branch participates in the Federal E-Verify system where the State will provide the federal government with each new hires Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information refer to our job seeker resources.

**Selection Process**
---------------------

The application and supplemental questionnaire are evaluated based upon a rating of your education, training and experience as they relate to the job requirements of the position. It is essential that you provide complete and accurate information on your application and the supplemental questionnaire to include dates of employment, job title and job duties. For education and training, list name of educational provider, training course titles and summary of course content. Narrative information supplied in response to the questions must be supported by the information supplied on the application including your employment, education and training history as it relates to the job requirements.

Once you have submitted your application on-line, all future correspondence related to your application will be sent via email. Please keep your contact information current. You may also view all correspondence sent to you by the State of Delaware in the “My Applications” tab at StateJobs.Delaware.gov.

**Accommodations**
------------------

Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities in all phases of the application and employment process.

Individuals who use TDD may request auxiliary aid or service by calling (800) 232-5470 or by visiting delawarerelay.com.

If you need assistance with an accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) or general applicant support, you may call (302) 739-5458 or email jobs@delaware.gov.

The State of Delaware is an Equal Opportunity employer and values a diverse workforce. We strongly encourage and seek out a workforce representative of Delaware including race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

33a069f511eadf5b5c8e.title: Quality Assurance Project Manager (QA PM)
33a069f511eadf5b5c8e.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking a **Quality Assurance Project Manager (QA PM)**. The Quality Assurance Project Manager (QA PM) is responsible for the full lifecycle supervision, coordination, and management of the BASIS Quality Assurance team. The QA PM leads all QA activities in strict compliance with DoDI 5000-87 and DevSecOps principles, encompassing functional and automated software testing, Section 508 accessibility compliance, weekend/scheduled maintenance window testing, and test case automation strategy. The QA PM serves as the primary interface between the QA team and Government stakeholders on all quality, compliance, and testing matters.

  

**This position is 100% Remote.**

### **1. QA Team Supervision & Management**

* Supervise, coordinate, and direct daily activities of the QA team, including testers, automation engineers, and Section 508 accessibility specialists
* Assign QA testers to projects to manage workload across Agile sprint cycles, ensuring QA activities align with the DevSecOps pipeline and release schedules
* Conduct performance evaluations, provide mentorship, and identify training needs for QA team personnel
* Establish and enforce QA standards, workflows, and documentation practices consistent with program requirements and Government-approved methodologies
* Facilitate QA team participation in sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives
* Maintain QA staffing levels and report personnel gaps or risks to the Program Manager

### **2. Software Functional Testing**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive functional testing strategy in alignment with DevSecOps principles
* Develop standard procedures and oversee compliance for the following testing types performed by the QA team:
  + **Integration and End-to-End Testing**
  + **QA Testing** —
  + **Verification & Validation (V&V) Testing**
  + **ProdSim / Stress Testing**
  + **Disaster Recovery Testing**
* Manage and deliver testing reports for each software package documenting the outcome of each test case and confirming full use case/requirements coverage
* Measure, track, and report code coverage metrics for all developed code on a per-release basis

### **3. Section 508 Accessibility Compliance**

* Lead all Section 508 (29 U.S.C. §794d) accessibility testing activities in conformance with WCAG 2.0 Level AA and 36 C.F.R. Part 1194
* Manage the QA team's execution of the following five compliance tasks:

  + **Conduct Accessibility Testing** — Ensure all deliverables are tested against Section 508 technical standards and functional performance criteria at planned intervals throughout the development lifecycle
  + **Correct Non-Conformance** — Ensure all identified accessibility deficiencies are corrected prior to final delivery
  + **Prepare Compliance Documentation** — Track delivery of a completed Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT), test results report, and remediation report for each ICT deliverable
  + **Generate Compliance Reports** — Deliver monthly status reports detailing Section 508 compliance activities and the conformance status of all active projects
  + **Produce Accessible User Documentation** — Ensure all user manuals, training materials, and supporting documentation are delivered in 508-compliant format
* Interface with Government representatives during Government-led 508 acceptance testing; coordinate timely remediation of any non-conforming deliverables
* Maintain a 508 compliance tracking log and report compliance posture in the Monthly Status Report (MSR)

### **4. Weekend & Scheduled Maintenance Window Testing**

* Plan, coordinate, and supervise all QA activities conducted during scheduled maintenance windows and weekend operations
* Manage QA team activities within the authorized production maintenance window (**Saturday 9:00 p.m. – Sunday 6:00 a.m. EST**), ensuring all maintenance and testing activities are completed within the approved window
* Oversee daily monitoring activities, ensuring monitoring is performed at the start of each workday and **prior to each weekend maintenance window** to confirm environment stability
* Coordinate UAT/Pre-UAT environment availability during Saturday hours (**8:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. EST**); ensure incident management processes are executed for any unscheduled outages during these hours
* Submit notification reports to the Government for any extended or unplanned maintenance outages impacting Production availability
* Manage QA resource scheduling to ensure adequate coverage during weekend testing windows without exceeding authorized maintenance hours

**Environment Availability Standards Managed by the QA PM:**

**Environment**

**Weekday Availability**

**Saturday Availability**

**Sunday**

**Production**

24×7

24×7 (maint. starts 9:00 p.m.)

Maint. ends 6:00 a.m.; 24×7 after

  

**UAT / Pre-UAT**

8:00 a.m. – 9:30 p.m. EST

8:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. EST

Not required

### **5. Test Case Automation**

* Champion an "Automation First" culture across the QA team
* Ensure all application testing is automated using Government-provided or Government-approved technologies, tools, and frameworks
* Manage and enforce the following automation requirements:
  + Automated test cases must be executable by the end of each Agile sprint
  + Automated tests must be incorporated into the DevSecOps pipeline prior to any release authorization
  + Test-Driven Development (TDD) is performed for all functional capabilities
  + Legacy test cases are automated per the Government-approved schedule to improve regression coverage
* Oversee delivery of the Automation Assessment Report (current state + completion estimate) and the Automation Project Plan for all non-automated backlog test cases
* Manage any exception requests for non-automatable test cases, ensuring written justification reports are prepared and submitted to the Government; track Government disposition of all exception requests
* Ensure continuous addition of all new sprint functionality into the automated testing suite across all option periods

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 6 years of experience, may have lead experience
* Must be a US Citizen
* Able to obtain Public Trust clearance
* Experience with QA testing environment
* Experience with DevSecOps principles
* Experience with creating test reports
* Experience with Maintain a 508 compliance tracking log

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* Certified Software Test Manager (CSTM) or equivalent QA certification
* Experience with TRICARE, DMDC, or Defense Health Agency (DHA) systems
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps)
* Experience with Test Case Management Systems (TCMS) used in a Government DevSecOps pipeline

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $86,000 - $138,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

**EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

106fae37877bfb601ced.title: MVA Inbound Call Agent – Remote / Work From Home
106fae37877bfb601ced.description:
MVA Inbound Call Agent – Remote / Work From Home

**Job Type:** Full-Time, Independent Contractor (Self-Employed)  
**Location:** Remote – Work From Home  
**Base Pay:** $500 USD per week (guaranteed, subject to completing the agreed working schedule)  
**Commission:** $1,000–$2,500 USD per month (performance-based earning potential)  
**Working Schedule:** 5 days per week, including every other Saturday  
**Overtime:** Additional paid hours available  
**Contract Type:** Independent Contractor Agreement

Job Description

We are looking for confident, motivated and professional **MVA Inbound Call Agents** to join our growing team specializing in Motor Vehicle Accident (MVA) and Personal Injury (PI) claims.

This is a **fully remote, self-employed contracting opportunity** offering a guaranteed weekly base payment alongside attractive performance-based commissions.

You will be responsible for handling inbound calls generated through our established marketing campaigns, speaking with customers who may have recently been involved in a motor vehicle accident.

Your primary responsibility will be to establish the reason for each call, identify potential MVA and Personal Injury opportunities, gather relevant information and transfer qualified customers to our dedicated sales closing team.

**This is an inbound position – no cold calling required.**

Key Responsibilities

* Answer inbound customer calls professionally and efficiently.
* Identify callers who have been involved in a motor vehicle accident.
* Filter out unrelated or non-qualifying enquiries.
* Establish accident circumstances, injuries and relevant claim information.
* Complete structured qualification questions to assess case eligibility.
* Build rapport with callers and provide excellent customer service.
* Warm transfer qualified opportunities to our experienced sales closing team.
* Maintain accurate records of customer information and call outcomes.
* Achieve individual performance and quality targets.
* Follow company scripts, procedures and compliance requirements.

Requirements

* **Previous telephone sales or call center experience is essential.**
* Previous **MVA / Personal Injury experience is highly desirable.**
* Excellent spoken English and a clear, professional telephone manner.
* Strong communication and active listening skills.
* Ability to identify sales opportunities and confidently engage customers.
* Comfortable handling high volumes of inbound calls.
* Target-driven, reliable and self-motivated.
* Ability to work independently from home.
* Reliable internet connection and a quiet working environment.

What We Offer

* **$500 USD guaranteed weekly base payment**, subject to completing the agreed working schedule.
* **$1,000–$2,500 USD potential monthly commission**, based on performance.
* **Total potential monthly earnings of approximately $3,167–$4,667**, including base payments and commission.
* **100% remote – work from home.**
* **5-day working week, including every other Saturday.**
* Additional paid hours available.
* Consistent inbound call volume from established marketing campaigns.
* No cold calling or lead sourcing required.
* Ongoing training and support.

Who We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience in **MVA intake, Personal Injury claims, insurance-related call centers or inbound telephone sales**.

The ideal candidate will be confident, personable and able to quickly identify qualified opportunities while maintaining a professional customer experience.

Contracting Arrangement

This opportunity is offered on an **independent contractor basis rather than as a traditional employment position**.

Successful applicants will work under an independent contractor agreement, with weekly base payments and additional performance-related commissions.

Contractors will be responsible for managing their own tax obligations in accordance with applicable laws.

How to Apply

Please apply through Indeed with your updated CV, highlighting any relevant inbound sales, call center, MVA or Personal Injury experience.

Alternatively, send your CV to:

**Admin@onlineautoclaimline.com**

Pay: $26,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Experience:

* Sales: 2 years (Required)
* Call center: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

bb5aa35e2be4f7834dff.title: Pharmacy Operations Manager
bb5aa35e2be4f7834dff.description:
**Job Summary**
  
Where state and federal laws/regulations allow, accountable for performing day-to-day non-clinical pharmacy operations, administrative activities; Ensures efficient pharmacy workflow and a positive patient experience. Serves as a full-time certified pharmacy technician. Responsible for operating pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. Under the supervision of a pharmacist, supervising pharmacy technicians and pharmacy cashiers within the guidelines of authorized company policies, laws, regulations and business ethics. Responsible for the selection, scheduling, and development of pharmacy technician personnel. Leads training, coaching, and performance management of pharmacy technicians. Makes decisions regarding performance management including discipline and termination.
  
  
**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer complaints, helps respond to customers’ requests in a timely manner and answers non-clinical questions to ensure a positive customer experience. Models and shares customer service best practices.
* Develops strong relationships with customers by anticipating customer needs and proactively offering services to provide the best experience possible when using the pharmacy. Enhances customer experience by increasing focus on healthcare services.

**Operations**

* Responsible for assisting pharmacist in the delivery of patient care including patient registration, prescription data entry, preparation of medications for patients, counting, and verifying (where allowed by law). Completes patient and physician calls under the supervision of a pharmacist (where allowed by law). Under the supervision of a pharmacist assists with healthcare service offerings including administering vaccines, health screenings, and any health services allowed by law.
* Within the guidelines of authorized company policies, state and federal laws/regulations, exercises independent judgment to delegate, direct, and assign non-clinical work in the pharmacy. Ensures tasks are completed on-time and holds others accountable for efficient workflow.
* At the direction of the Pharmacy Manager or pharmacist, prepares, and files reports and records required by the company and various government agencies.
* Manages core pharmacy workflow and drives excellence in pharmacy operations. Coordinates and organizes pharmacy daily schedule of activities. Recommends allocation of pharmacy hours. Assures the pharmacy is clean, neat, orderly, and stocked with adequate supplies.
* Under the direction of the pharmacist, exercises independent judgment to ensure compliance and execution of all business administrative activities and pharmacy inventory management tasks that do not require pharmacist licensure. Manages annual inventory preparation.
* Accountable for completion of non-clinical patient calls.
* Drives new technology/ process roll out, champions change and engages team around action planning. Assures proper operation and maintenance of pharmacy department equipment. In collaboration with Pharmacy Manager, responsible for recordkeeping and ensuring security safeguards are in-place.
* Under supervision of the pharmacist, strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription-dispensing activities and understands their role in ensuring that the elements of Good Faith Dispensing are met.
* Maintains and applies knowledge of Company asset protection techniques. Supports Pharmacy Manager with diversion monitoring and reports any concerns that would compromise the security of the pharmacy to the Pharmacy Manager.
* Communicates prescription errors to the accountable pharmacist, and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Continuous Quality Improvement Program.
* Ensures the accurate processing of insurance claims to resolve customer issues and prevent payment rejections. Follows-up with insurance companies as well as medical providers and conducts or participates in 3rd party audit.
* Assists and supports Store Manager and Pharmacy Manager in analyzing and seeking to improve pharmacy financials, operational quality and customer service.
* Manages Community Outreach Portal and coordinates and, at the direction of the Pharmacy Manager, assigns pharmacists to off-site immunization clinics and community events. Builds and sustains relationships with retail partnerships.

**People & Performance Management**

* Leads performance management of technicians including making decisions and recommendations regarding discipline and termination. Follows constructive discipline policy to discipline, suspend, terminate or effectively recommend the same. Uses constructive discipline policy to ensure pharmacy technicians are compliant with state and federal laws. Holds technician accountable for attendance and timeliness. Maintains and improves performance of pharmacy through team member engagement and action planning.
* Accountable for technician hiring, on-boarding, training, and scheduling. Monitors and holds pharmacy technicians accountable for timely training completion. Follows established policies and procedures set by the company for scheduling and training.
* Accountable for identifying gaps in pharmacy operations knowledge among team members and supporting those team members in their training, either through hands-on training or assignment of learning modules.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager in monitoring that all pharmacy and team member licensures, registrations and certifications are active and in good standing/ compliant with all regulatory and legal requirements. Leverages Walgreens resources such as Walgreens Online Verification System to assist in documenting licensure status.
* Ensures proper procedures are followed for selection, recruitment, record retention, and training as required by Company policy and local, state and federal laws.

**Training & Personal Development**

* Maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration.
* Maintains and enhances current knowledge and skills related to pharmacy and healthcare.
* Obtains necessary certifications, education credits and training such as LTMP e-modules as required by the Company. Follows performance improvement plans offered by Pharmacy Manager.
* Seeks professional development by monitoring one’s own performance, solicits for constructive feedback, and leverages Healthcare Supervisor as mentor and coach.

**Communication**

* Communicates with pharmacy team, relaying messages from the support center or other key emails as required.
* Participates in key store/pharmacy meetings, including 5-minute meetings and weekly check-ins with the Store Manager
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
* PTCB certification (except in Puerto Rico).
* Has one year of work experience as a pharmacy technician in a retail or hospital setting.
* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English (except in Puerto Rico).
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
* Willingness to obtain active immunization certification within 90 days of hire (except in Community Specialty Pharmacy and Health System Pharmacy locations)
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Previous people management/ leadership experience.
* Previous work experience with Walgreens with an Exceeding Expectation on last performance evaluation.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
This information is being provided to promote pay transparency and equal employment opportunities at Walgreens. The current hourly range for this position is $22.50 per hour - $35.75 per hour. The actual hourly rate within this range that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience and other relevant factors. This role will remain open until filled. To review benefits, please click here jobs.walgreens.com/benefits. If you are applying on a job board or unable to click on the link, please copy and paste this URL into your browser jobs.walgreens.com/benefits
  
**Salary Range:** Hourly

------------

* ### **Health, dental and vision\***
* ### **Prescription coverage**
* ### **Retirement Savings Plan (401(k))**
* ### **Employee discount**
* ### **Work & life resources**
* ### **Career development programs**

**Position Summary**

At DSV, the **Senior Industrial Engineer** will support projects implementing new and existing business, site consolidations and relocations, and automation solutions. Additionally, this role will actively support the creation, validation, and use of tools and standards for both the department and DSV organization. All activities shall be completed with strict DSV organizational requirements for Safety, Quality, and Financial responsibility.

**This role can sit remote or onsite at a DSV location in the US / NA**\*\* **Expected travel range: 50%** \*\*

  

For new or expanding business, the Senior Industrial Engineer core focus is to validate customer requirements, create the overall solution, and implement the owned tasks associated with the solution. The engineer is to provide feedback to the Project Manager for the project on estimated time, status, escalation, and scope changes regarding their assigned tasks within the DSV standard project delivery approach.

  

For warehouse consolidation, relocation, or new real estate projects, the Senior Industrial Engineer will be responsible for collecting and collating all customer requirements for those to be relocated including but not limited to electrical, data, IT equipment, MHE, storage, automation, and any regulatory or security certifications and requirements. Interaction with the greenfield or brownfield general contractor for all building shell and property requirements within the project scope.

  

Other tasks may include standardization adherence and development or continuous improvement support. Vendor onboarding and budgeting support. New team member peer coaching. Internal and external partnership and collaboration.

  

Engineering focus can be on either new or existing distribution operations. Successful candidates will be natural self-starters.

  

* *Expected travel range: 50%*

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of warehouse and distribution center solutions including facility layouts, operational processes, and equipment selection.
* Analyze and optimize operational workflows, including inbound, putaway, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and value-added services (VAS), to ensure efficient and scalable execution.
* Define facility, process, and equipment requirements and gain stakeholder alignment on final solution designs.
* Support design and implementation of warehouse technologies and distribution systems, including WMS or other related operational platforms, to maximize performance and operational effectiveness.
* Develop detailed implementation plans, schedules, and task lists to support successful project delivery in partnership with Project Managers and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify, evaluate, and procure capital equipment and other required assets to support operational start-up and long-term business objectives.
* Manage vendor, supplier, contractor, and customer relationships throughout project execution.
* Support the implementation and integration of automation and material handling solutions within distribution and fulfillment operations as a part of the overall engineering design.
* Ensure all solutions comply with applicable customer requirements, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Coordinate multiple projects and priorities simultaneously while proactively identifying risks, resolving issues, and driving successful project outcomes.
* Develop and deliver project updates, business cases, presentations, and recommendations to leadership, customers, and executive stakeholders.
* Collaborate with operations, engineering, IT, construction, and external partners to ensure successful project execution and operational readiness.
* Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative supply chain solutions to continuously improve operational performance and design standards.
* Support project activities within warehouse and construction environments, including travel, site assessments, commissioning, testing, and operational launches.
* Travel as required to support project implementations, customer engagements, and business initiatives.
* Perform additional duties and special projects related to operational improvements, new business implementations, network expansions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**Required Skills**

**Education and/or Experience**

* Four-year degree is basic requirement (Industrial Engineering preferred)
* Minimum of 6 years in the Logistics/Supply Chain Industry
* Minimum of 4 years’ experience in warehousing solution implementation and design
  

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations**

None required

**Computer Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Project, Vizio, and use of Teams / SharePoint
* AutoCAD LT
* Knowledge of WMS functional processes
* Knowledge of LMS, TMS, YMS (nice to have)
  

**Language Skills**

* English (reading, writing, verbal), Spanish a plus
* Interpersonal communication and language skills (e.g., listening to others, speaking to others, reading, writing).
* Communication (facilitation skills and very mature communication skills to be able to communicate to all levels in the organization).
* Strong writing skills with experience documenting design methodologies to create logistics solutions and responses to RFPs.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience dealing with end users, vendors, and clients.
* Experience in 3PL environment
* Six Sigma / Lean Certifications (a plus)
* Diverse solution experience for multiple different business channels including but not limited to Consumer Products, Retail, Manufacturing Support, and E-commerce.
* Experience with various size and scope complexity projects from a design and implementation standpoint for warehouse solutions.
* Experience in warehouse automation applications (Pick to Light, Goods to Person, Automated Sortation, AMR, AGV, conveyor design, etc.)
* Experience supporting BRD (business requirements document) creation, holistic detailed design, procurement, and vendor management for project implementations.
  

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* As Assigned: management of vendors completing work tasks for the project.
* May Be: identified to support onboarding of peers.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear. The employee uses computer and telephone equipment. Specific vision requirements of this job include close vision and distance vision. Must be able to lift up to 40 lbs. while following proper lifting procedures. Must be able to stand on feet for up to 8 hours per day.

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The physical demands and work environment characteristics described above are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

e23abca027448150c76f.description:
**Location:** Remote
  
**Work Type:** Full Time Regular
  
**Job No:** 505403
  
**Categories:** Information Technology, Project Management/Business Analyst
  
**Application Closes:** Open Until Filled

2026-11-15

As a QA Analyst focused on APIs, you will play a key role in advancing mission-critical capabilities that support the future of Workplace Solutions. This role blends quality assurance, systems analysis, test strategy, technical problem solving, API validation, and automated and manual testing to help deliver reliable, scalable solutions for our Benefit Administrator partners. You will collaborate with business and technology teams, connect end-to-end system behavior to quality outcomes, and help ensure solutions improve efficiency, quality, and the customer experience.

**WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:**

* Estimated Salary: $76,000 - $92,000 depending on skills and qualifications, plus annual bonus opportunity.
* 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
* Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
* Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Partner with business and technology teams to ensure API-enabled solutions that support Workplace Solutions initiatives meet quality standards and improve outcomes for Benefit Administrator partners.
* Analyze end-to-end system behavior, data flows, requirements, dependencies, and assumptions to define test coverage and validate that solutions perform as expected across integrated systems.
* Review requirements for clarity and testability, and maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results as needs evolve.
* Create clear QA documentation, including test plans, test cases, test data, defect reports, and test result summaries that support solution delivery and long-term maintainability.
* Lead or support test planning and execution for functional areas, including manual and automated API testing for enhancements, upgrades, regression, and ongoing maintenance.
* Investigate defects and ambiguous issues using structured problem solving, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based recommendations to support sound release decisions.
* Facilitate productive discussions with developers, business partners, and other stakeholders to triage defects, clarify expected behavior, and promote shared understanding of quality risks.
* Identify opportunities to improve test processes, automation coverage, and delivery practices while setting quality expectations and supporting continuous improvement.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* 4+ years of QA analysis experience, including hands-on experience analyzing, testing, and validating API functionality.
* Experience using API testing tools such as Postman and Swagger to validate functionality and security.
* Strong technical and systems acumen, with the ability to interpret architecture, tools, processes, data flows, and integration patterns and translate them into feasible testing scenarios and cases.
* Proficiency with automated testing frameworks such as Karate, including the ability to design, execute, and maintain automated API test scripts that enhance test coverage, streamline validation, and improve software quality and reliability.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices, including integrating automated API tests into build and deployment pipelines to support continuous testing and release readiness.
* Experience planning and executing performance and load testing of APIs, including analyzing response times, throughput, and scalability under expected and peak volumes.
* Demonstrated ability to break down moderately complex or ambiguous requirements and system behavior, evaluate quality risks, structure testing strategies, and recommend testing actions.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience building trusted stakeholder relationships, balancing perspectives, addressing concerns, and helping negotiate test scope, priorities, and release-readiness tradeoffs.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the ability to bridge quality needs with business scenarios and technical solutions.

**PREFERRED:**

* Experience supporting secure and accurate employee and benefit data exchanges with technical third-party Benefit Administrator partners through API integrations.
* Prior experience working in the insurance industry.
* Experience using AI-assisted testing tools to generate test cases and test data, accelerate test automation, and improve defect analysis.

8ebd011d93ae0a189d8a.description:
**Job Description**

**Timmons Group** is currently hiring a **Senior Quality Assurance Analyst** to join our Geospatial Solutions Development team, working remotely. This position will be supporting west coast clients and will be expected to work PST work hours. This position owns the testing process for a multi-year state government modernization program, delivered in sprints and releases under formal contract governance, independent verification and validation (IV&V), and change control. The position may also lead and support quality efforts for our other state, local, federal, and non-government clients.

This position is accountable to prove that what we deliver works, traces to approved requirements, and is ready for client testers to run on their own. The role sets the test strategy, leads QA, holds the quality gates for each story and release, and covers both functional and non-functional testing. It calls for close attention to detail and the judgment to tell a defect from a change in scope. We welcome candidates from consulting firms and from state or local government who have led testing on governed technology programs.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* Own the end-to-end testing process, from test strategy and planning through release acceptance
* Maintain the test plan as a living document, including test levels and types, environments, entry and exit criteria, roles, and reporting
* Lead and review the work of QA analysts, assigning testing by story, capacity, and skill
* Ensure every acceptance criterion has a clear test case that any tester can run without help
* Direct functional, integration, database validation, smoke, regression, end-to-end, and UAT support testing
* Plan and coordinate non-functional testing, including performance, load, security, recovery, and accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
* Maintain requirements traceability from requirement to story, test case, result, and defect
* Own the defect lifecycle and lead triage with client stakeholders, applying severity, priority, and release gates consistently
* Identify findings that are scope changes rather than defects and route them through change control with an impact analysis
* Produce test evidence and reports that support contract deliverables, IV&V reviews, and release acceptance
* Prepare client testers for each testing window and support their move from paired to independent testing
* Work with developers to expand automated testing in the CI pipeline and keep clear what is automated and what is manual
* Review AI-drafted test cases for coverage and intent before they are used
* Report test progress, defect trends, and release readiness to the project team and client

**Skills/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 7+ years in software quality assurance, including 3+ years leading testing and owning the test process from plan through release is required
* Experience testing under formal governance, including written test plans, requirements traceability, contract deliverables, and change control; state government or IV&V experience is a plus
* Hands-on functional testing experience across integration, regression, end-to-end, database validation, and UAT
* Experience planning and interpreting non-functional testing, including performance, security scanning, and accessibility
* Strong defect management and triage skills, including working directly with client testers and stakeholders
* Exceptional attention to detail, with test cases and evidence that hold up to client and auditor review
* Experience with test automation (for example Playwright or Selenium) in a CI pipeline; experience testing geospatial applications and/or experience using ArcGIS Pro is a plus
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences; ISTQB or similar certifications are desirable
* Ability to work Pacific Time business hours for client testing windows and triage; comfort using AI tools in day-to-day work
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps Test Plans, Microsoft 365, and Smartsheet, or comparable tools

**Compensation:** Our best estimate of the salary range for this position is $80,000-$120,000. There may be flexibility on salary for experienced candidates. Offers are based on a range of job-related factors such as internal equity, experience, skills, education, credentials, role complexity, and location. Information on our comprehensive benefits package can be found here

 **Additional Information**

The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

We are looking for high energy, creative, flexible, patient, self-starters who are willing to work at a dynamic pace. Candidates must share a commitment to our company’s Vision, Mission and Shared Values.

**Timmons Group is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected Veteran status.**

**Timmons Group** is a multi-disciplined firm recognized nationally as a “Best Firm to Work For”. We help government and private clients alike to scale and grow through GIS services. With over 30 years providing expert GIS services, our award-winning team is ready to provide the flexible services to meet the needs of any organization. Our service expertise ranges from traditional GIS architecture and system configuration to custom application development to Enterprise Asset Management. We pride ourselves in being technology professionals that differentiate our services with unrivaled customer service. We are dedicated to solving challenges and helping our clients achieve their vision. For more information, visit www.timmonsgis.com.

61fa400711a846714e22.title: QA Coordinator
61fa400711a846714e22.description:
The Quality Assurance (QA) Coordinator serves as both a shift supervisor and quality inspector, ensuring that production lines operate efficiently, sanitation standards are upheld, and all products meet established quality and safety requirements. This role plays a key part in verifying thermal process parameters, supporting regulatory compliance, and maintaining the integrity of all quality assurance programs.

* Oversees and coordinates daily departmental quality assurance activities.
* Reviews and evaluates the quality of all products produced during the shift.
* Ensures any questionable product is placed on QA hold, properly red‑tagged, segregated, and accurately documented for management review.
* Verifies all process parameters on the production floor and at all cooker systems.
* Conducts verification of thermal processes during deviations, determines alternate processes when necessary, and ensures proper segregation and documentation to maintain product safety and regulatory compliance.

add4a216fa7b3ff3ae83.description:
**Founder Brand & Thought Leadership Lead (US)**

**Location:** Remote, US-based (San Francisco, CA preferred)

**Type:** Full-time or long-term contractor

**Reports to:** Marc Tuscher, Co-Founder & CTO

**About us and the role**
-------------------------

Sereact builds AI software that lets robots see, understand and handle objects in real-world warehouses. We are growing fast in the US, and we want our co-founder Marc Tuscher to become one of the most recognized voices in physical AI and warehouse automation there.

You will own that mission end to end. You will run his presence on LinkedIn and X, get him into the right podcasts, publications and stages, and turn every appearance into content. Think of yourself as his chief of staff for public voice, not a social media scheduler. This is not a classic marketing role: you won't run ads, campaigns or lead generation. Your job is to build trust and authority around one person, mostly through earned media that can't be bought.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the narrative.** Define 2–3 core themes and a clear point of view for Marc, together with him and our leadership team.
* **Run LinkedIn and X.** Draft, edit and publish posts in his voice, several times a week. Engage with comments, build relationships with relevant voices and grow a following among US operations, supply chain and robotics leaders.
* **Tell Sereact's stories every day.** Collect daily wins, milestones and behind-the-scenes stories from all Sereact locations and customer sites (new deployments, robots going live, customer results, the people behind them) and tell them through Marc's eyes: what he learned, what surprised him, why it matters for the industry. Work with our teams and customers on approvals, photos and video, within customer confidentiality.
* **Book podcasts.** Identify the right shows in AI, robotics, logistics, manufacturing and startups, pitch hosts and prepare him for each recording.
* **Land bylines and press.** Find target publications (trade and business media), pitch op-eds and interviews, and work with journalists and, if needed, a PR agency.
* **Secure stages.** Get him speaking slots at US conferences, trade shows and industry dinners, and submit award and list nominations.
* **Repurpose everything.** Turn each podcast, talk or article into clips, posts and newsletter content.
* **Measure what matters.** Track reach within our target audience, inbound leads, media mentions and booked appearances, and report monthly.

**How you work with our marketing team**
----------------------------------------

Our marketing team owns the Sereact brand, website, campaigns, trade show booths and lead generation. You own Marc's personal voice and his earned media: his LinkedIn and X accounts, podcasts, bylines, interviews and talks.

Stories, approvals and big moments are planned together in the middle; each side then tells them in its own voice and is measured on its own results.

* You share customer stories and milestones with marketing, so one story can live on Marc's account and on Sereact's channels without duplicate work.
* You align with marketing on key moments such as product launches, funding news and major trade shows, and plan his appearances around them.
* Customer approvals run through one shared process, so customers are asked once, not twice.
* Your success is measured differently: not by leads or ad performance, but by appearances, media mentions, reach among US decision-makers and the inbound conversations he gets as a result.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in executive communications, founder branding, PR or journalism, ideally in tech or deep tech. A background mainly in performance or campaign marketing is not what we're looking for.
* A track record of building a founder's or executive's presence on LinkedIn and/or X, with examples and numbers you can show us.
* An existing network of podcast hosts, journalists, editors or event organizers in the US.
* Excellent writing in American English: you can capture someone else's voice and make technical topics sharp and human.
* Strong judgment on what to say and what not to say publicly.
* Self-starter mindset: you work independently across time zones with a team based in Germany.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in robotics, AI, logistics, supply chain or manufacturing.
* Short-form video skills (editing clips for LinkedIn, X and YouTube).
* Experience with newsletters (Substack, beehiiv) or running a podcast.
* Knowledge of US industry events such as ProMat, MODEX, Automate or CES.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Direct, daily work with a founder at a fast-growing AI and robotics company.
* Real ownership: you shape the strategy, not just execute it.
* Budget for tools, travel to US events and occasional trips to our team in Germany.
* Flexible, remote-first setup.
* Competitive salary and benefits

**How to apply**
----------------

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and 2–3 examples of executives or founders whose presence you built, with the results. Tell us in a few sentences how you would position Marc in his first 90 days.
